scenario.operatorMessage: What if the truck is delayed another 30 minutes?

summary: ZRH feasible · FRA tight on volume · AYC 7842 rejected · AYC 7843 +18 h

options.title: Keep AYC 7841 via LEJ
options.constraint_check: Truck arrives after the LEJ cut-off. The station will not accept it.
options.action: Present AWB 615-12345675 to AYC 7841 only if LEJ accepts a late tender.

options.title: Roll to AYC 7842
options.constraint_check: AYC 7842 has 410 kg free. This shipment is 780 kg. Capacity is not theoretical — it is short.

options.title: Rebook via ZRH
options.constraint_check: RFS 2204 leaves GVA at 18:10, on hand ZRH 19:05, cut-off 21:30. Free capacity 2,200 kg and a loose position. Dispatch in the next 15 minutes.
options.action: Pull AWB 615-12345675 off RFS 1840 and move it to RFS 2204 for AYC 9864 ZRH–DEL.

options.title: Rebook via FRA
options.constraint_check: Weight fits (900 kg free) but the remaining LD3 is 4.3 m³ against 4.2 m³ built. No contour tolerance.
options.action: Move the shipment to RFS 3310 GVA–FRA for AYC 552, and flag the volume as tight.

options.title: Wait for AYC 7843
options.constraint_check: Space is clean (3,100 kg) but the customer window on 15 Oct is missed by a full day.
options.action: Hold at LEJ for AYC 7843 and warn the customer of +18 h.

submitted.summary: The truck delay causes a 60‑minute miss of the LEJ cut‑off, putting the connection at critical risk. Recommend rebooking via Zurich (RFS 2204 → AYC 9864) to deliver by 15 Oct 13:10 LT.
why: Truck ETA 20:15 LT vs Need‑by 19:15 LT gives a 60‑minute shortfall (gap 60 min short) and misses the LEJ cut‑off 20:00 LT.
Weight 780 kg exceeds the 410 kg free on AYC 7842, keeping the current flight is blocked.
Rebooking via ZRH (RFS 2204 → AYC 9864) delivers at 15 Oct 13:10 LT (+4 h) with cost +CHF 180 and Low risk.
Alternative via FRA gives +9 h delay at +CHF 90 (Medium risk); waiting for AYC 7843 adds +18 h (High risk).
submitted.reply: Before: truck ETA 19:45 LT (scheduled 18:15 LT + 90 min), 30 min after need‑by 19:15 LT but still before LEJ cut‑off 20:00 LT. After: truck ETA 20:15 LT (+120 min), 60 min short of need‑by 19:15 LT and past cut‑off 20:00 LT, risk critical; recommend rebooking via ZRH (RFS 2204 → AYC 9864) for delivery 15 Oct 13:10 LT (+4 h, +CHF 180).
submitted.customer_note: AWB 615-12345675 : nouvelle livraison prévue le 15 oct. à 13:10 LT (retard de +4 h).
